fields.title: Col4a3 mouse glomerular datasets
fields.description: Glomeruli were isolated from Col4a3-/- and Ctrl mice. The extracellular matrix was enriched and both cellular and matrix fraction were analysed by mass spectrometry.
fields.keywords: kidney, glomerulus, extracellular matrix, Col4a3, mouse
fields.reference_titles: Identification of an Altered Matrix Signature in Kidney Aging and Disease
